dialogues.speaker: Aclla
dialogues.text: Hi there, what can I help you with?

dialogues.speaker: Aclla
dialogues.text: Or is there anything you wanted to help the Scions of the Canopy with?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About my reputation with the Scions of the Canopy...

dialogues.speaker: Aclla
dialogues.text: So you really are a helper after all! Thank you so much!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hello. What did you mean when you said "help"?

dialogues.speaker: Aclla
dialogues.text: Ah, let me explain. Often, members of the tribe just have too much on their hands, so some turn into commissions that are open to outsiders as well.

dialogues.speaker: Aclla
dialogues.text: Anyone who wants to take on a commission can just come here, to the Obsidian Totem Pole.

dialogues.speaker: Aclla
dialogues.text: Naturally, you'll be compensated for completing commissions! Feel free to stop by and help!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And you are...

dialogues.speaker: Aclla
dialogues.text: I'm a vet who specializes in treating Saurians. Pleasure to meet you!

dialogues.speaker: Aclla
dialogues.text: Haha, it may sound cool, but I really just give baby Saurians their meds and talk to them. At most, I could be considered a medical intern.

dialogues.speaker: Aclla
dialogues.text: For seriously injured Saurians, it's best if you see a professional Sauro-vet.

dialogues.speaker: Aclla
dialogues.text: Like Ifa, from the Flower-Feather Clan! If you give him a call, he'll rush right on over!

dialogues.speaker: Aclla
dialogues.text: Of course, I've got some pretty neat talents too! You know how Yumkasaurs usually don't like being around people? Well, they don't mind me!

dialogues.speaker: Aclla
dialogues.text: Sometimes, just spending time with them is a kind of healing.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got other things to do right now...

dialogues.speaker: Aclla
dialogues.text: Take care, then.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And you are...?

dialogues.speaker: Aclla
dialogues.text: I'm a vet who specializes in treating Saurians. A pleasure to meet you!

dialogues.speaker: Aclla
dialogues.text: Haha, it may sound cool, but I really just give baby Saurians their meds and talk to them. At most, I could be considered a medical intern.

dialogues.speaker: Aclla
dialogues.text: For seriously injured Saurians, it's best if you see a professional Sauro-vet.

dialogues.speaker: Aclla
dialogues.text: Like Ifa, from the Flower-Feather Clan! If you give him a call, he'll rush right on over!

dialogues.speaker: Aclla
dialogues.text: Of course, I've got some pretty neat talents too! You know how Yumkasaurs usually don't like being around people? Well, they don't mind me!

dialogues.speaker: Aclla
dialogues.text: Sometimes, little Saurians look unwell, but they're actually just in a bad mood... So, spending time with them can be an excellent form of "treatment," you know!
